description: Four-turn BLUE order sequence against the fixed prototype map with the RED LLM profile disabled, so RED orders come from the deterministic staff planner. The sequence deliberately avoids completing a third BLUE objective, because the prototype's scoring would otherwise end the game during turn 1.

requests.intent: Spend the full 10 CP on one op from each effect family: deception, counter-deception, fortification, and presence movement. R-04 is deliberately not attacked; taking it completes BLUE's public objective set and ends the game immediately.

Exercise link interdiction and jamming, then deliberately overrun the CP budget. SECURE_CORRIDOR takes the running total to 11 of 10 CP and is rejected; the trailing 2 CP sweep would have fit in the remaining budget but is dropped too, which records the prototype's first-over-budget-stops-everything behavior.
Seed a second rumor, sweep BLUE's own back line for RED deception, and shift presence again while the turn-2 interdiction and jamming timers decay.
Commit no BLUE operations so one adjudication is driven entirely by the RED staff planner and the decay/timer path.
